panels.text: Mohan job શોધી રહ્યો હતો. Instagram પર ad આવ્યો: 'ઘરે બેઠા ₹50,000/month!'
Message: 'Amazon work-from-home. ₹50,000/month. Registration fee ₹999 only. Limited seats!'
redFlags: Amazon ક્યારેય WhatsApp / Instagram પર job offer ન કરે
'Registration fee' — real job ક્યારેય fee ન લે
'Limited seats! Hurry!' — ઉતાવળ ઉભી કરે છે

panels.question: Mohan શું કરે?
panels.correct: Company ની official website check કરો, fee ન ભરો

panels.wrongOutcome: ❌ ₹999 pay → 'training fee' ₹2000 → 'kit fee' ₹3000 → job ન મળ્યો 😢
panels.rightOutcome: ✅ Mohan officially apply કર્યો → real job found! 🎉

panels.rule: Real job ક્યારેય 'registration fee' ન માંગે.
panels.subtext: Instagram / WhatsApp job offer = ઠગ. Amazon, Flipkart directly hire કરે — fee વિના.

panels.text: Mohan was job hunting. An Instagram ad appeared: 'Earn ₹50,000/month from home!'
Message: 'Amazon work-from-home. ₹50,000/month. Registration fee ₹999 only. Limited seats!'
redFlags: Amazon never offers jobs via WhatsApp or Instagram
'Registration fee' — real jobs never charge a fee
'Limited seats! Hurry!' — artificial urgency is a trick

panels.question: What should Mohan do?
panels.correct: Check the company's official website, don't pay any fee

panels.rightOutcome: ✅ Mohan applied officially → found a real job! 🎉

panels.rule: Real jobs never ask for a registration fee.
panels.subtext: Instagram / WhatsApp job offers = scams. Amazon, Flipkart hire directly — no fee.

quiz.gu: Instagram ad: 'ઘરે બેઠા ₹40,000/month, fee ₹500' — આ શું છે?
quiz.en: Instagram ad: 'Earn ₹40,000/month from home, fee ₹500' — what is this?

explanation.gu: Real job fee ન લે — fee = ઠગ.
explanation.en: Real jobs don't charge fees — fee = scam.

quiz.gu: Job offer WhatsApp / Instagram પર — real company ક્યારે ન send કરે?
quiz.en: Job offers on WhatsApp / Instagram — when do real companies NOT send these?

explanation.gu: Real companies official websites / job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn) ઉપર hire કરે.
explanation.en: Real companies hire through official websites / job portals like Naukri, LinkedIn.

quiz.gu: 'Limited seats! Apply now!' — આ ઠગ ક્યારે use કરે?
quiz.en: 'Limited seats! Apply now!' — why do scammers say this?

gu: ઉતાવળ ઉભી કરી — think ન કરો
en: To rush you — so you don't think

explanation.gu: Urgency = ઠગ ની trick. Time લો, verify કરો.
explanation.en: Urgency = scammer's trick. Take your time and verify.
